rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Picture this: Two individuals, the one standing is full of malice, the other lying down is honorable and righteous. How can the one who's lying down label the one standing as "sinister?"
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: In the throes of combat, where life and death hinge on a singular moment, every idea fades into nothingness. The only thing that matters is "staying alive."
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Surviving the battlefield reshapes all notions of worth. Be it integrity or treachery, in my eyes, their significance is negligible.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Perhaps you've underestimated Yunli and me, Mr. Jiaoqiu. We may be young, but we've seen our fair share of war.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Well, well, then you should know that the Wardance is nothing more than a contest. So, why are you so focused on it?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: When I was appointed as the ringmaster for the Wardance, I asked the general: "We Cloud Knights are supposed to charge into the fray and slay enemies. Why do we have to swing swords in a ring just to please an audience?"
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: And this is how the general replied: "To unsheathe your sword in a ring is no different than on the battlefield, as your sword reveals the might of all Cloud Knights."
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: The Wardance is the perfect chance to showcase martial virtue and forge alliances from all over the cosmos. When we unsheathe the sword without drawing blood, we not only display our might but also the martial virtue of the Cloud Knights.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: That's quite an insightful statement, Yanqing. Well, my apologies for being so short-sighted. I've been on the Luofu for quite some time, but I haven't had the chance to see the ceremony venue for myself yet.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Hearing you speak so highly of it has piqued my curiosity. Would you mind showing me around?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: You want to see the Skysplitter ship where the Wardance will be held? Let's go! I bet Yunli and Miss March haven't seen it either, right? Well then, I'll give you all a tour.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Let's go. I'll give you a tour of the Skysplitter.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: (Head to Stargazer Navalia)
(Go later)
Looks like a lot of other visitors have also come to catch a glimpse of the Skysplitter.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: What's up, Mr. Jiaoqiu?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: No... it's nothing.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Do you see that airship in the distance? That's the Skysplitter, the venue for the Wardance ceremony.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: It doesn't look all that impressive from this distance.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: The Skysplitter is actually a decommissioned Luofu military vessel. People aren't allowed on board until the Wardance officially commences.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Tomorrow, when the bell rings and the ceremonial cannons roar, I'll be there representing the Cloud Knights of the Xianzhou Luofu, standing in the ring, ready to take on challengers from all over the cosmos.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Since I was a kid, I've been training in swordplay and the art of war under the General. Every day I'd swing my sword ten thousand times, and then thrust it ten thousand times, repeating the process over and over...
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: I understand that I'm not like other kids. I never envied the toys and freedom they all had. I never found sword practice boring or hard.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Even in the thick of battle, facing down savage abominations, I never felt scared.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Each day, I could feel myself getting stronger and stronger... and I racked up countless victories. It's the best feeling in the world.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: But then, I faced a really tough opponent, and just one slash shattered my confidence into a thousand pieces. That's when I felt true fear for the first time. Maybe that's what Mr. Jiaoqiu meant by "life and death hinge on a singular moment, every idea fades into nothingness?"
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: After that, I had to pick up the pieces and try to put myself back together. But no matter how hard I tried, I couldn't seem to find my old, happy self again.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: I often ask myself, why do I wield my sword? If defeat is inevitable, why do I continue to fight? Is it to reclaim the joy of victory, to meet the general's expectations, or to secure my honor among the Cloud Knights?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: While the general could teach me the art of swordplay, he couldn't teach me why I should keep on going. He said the reason must come from within myself. I've been struggling to find that reason.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: But after talking with you, Mr. Jiaoqiu, I think I already have that reason in mind.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: As a member of the Cloud Knights and the general's apprentice, I've had a weight on my shoulders, and I know there's still more to shoulder.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: But when I wield my sword, it feels like I'm letting go of everything. I love the feeling of giving it my all, facing any obstacle in front of me, pressing forward.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: That's why I wield my sword.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Oh, Yanqing, so young, yet so grown-up... By the way, how old are you exactly?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Age doesn't really matter. All swordmasters will understand how I feel.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Hmm... I get it. Looks like all the kids on the Luofu live tough lives. So, how about you, Miss Yunli?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: It's not polite to ask a girl her age, no matter which Xianzhou ship you're on.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: I'm not asking your age! I'm asking if you have a dream like Yanqing has?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: You don't talk like a cook, you sound more like a TV host or something.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: ...Need I repeat myself again? I'm a healer.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Well, I... I don't have a dream like Yanqing does. The only reason I'm participating in the Ringmaster's Challenge is because I made a promise to my grandfather. I wanna win the precious sword he's contributed to the Wardance.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Jiaoqiu waves and then leaves...
Sounds like that mind of yours is just filled with swords.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: I bet you've got nothing better on your mind!
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: My... father... was a craftsman on the Xianzhou Zhuming. Because of his foolishness, many innocent people fell victim to the cursed swords he forged.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Since I was a kid, it's been clear to me that not everyone deserves to have a weapon in their hands. Giving them a sword is no different than being cruel to the innocent.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: So, whenever I come across someone unworthy of a sword, I can't help but want to take it away from them. Given that Yanqing is the Wardance ringmaster, I'm stepping up to challenge him, to ensure the precious sword doesn't fall into the hands of an unworthy master.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Hey! What do you mean by "an unworthy master"?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: I see. It's not easy for kids on the Zhuming either.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Well, it's better to have a reason for wielding a sword than to be lost and confused. I've saved countless Cloud Knights in my life, and there are plenty of exceptional warriors just like the two... of you...
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: What happened, Mr. Jiaoqiu?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: ...Oh, nothing. I was just reminded of some old friends and old tales.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Judging from my professional perspective as a healer, both of you possess remarkable vitality, your energies flow like raging fires and mighty gales. The upcoming fight... will definitely be impressive.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Well, we've seen the Skysplitter and toured the Stargazer Navalia. I guess it's time to say goodbye for now.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: What, you're leaving already? But you haven't asked me about my dreams! I've been working hard too, you know!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's getting late, Miss March. Unlike you lot, I'm a grown-up bound by responsibilities and duties. The tasks entrusted to me by the general won't complete themselves.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: By the way, Yanqing, is it normal to have so many people wandering around in an automated area like the Stargazer Navalia?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: ...Actually, this is a restricted area, but since you're all guests, I made an exception so you could take a look around.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: I understand. Well, I'll take my leave. I wish you both the best of luck in the ring tomorrow.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Seriously... I just spent so much time thinking about my dream, but he didn't even ask me!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Now that we're done with our tour of the Skysplitter, shall we continue with our training?
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Why don't we take a day off?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: What? You want to secretly practice swordplay by yourself? Dream on.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Hmph, you know cramming before a fight never works out.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: For some reason, seeing the Skysplitter has boosted my confidence. So, I've decided to conserve my strength for tomorrow.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Alright, I'll take you out of the Stargazer Navalia.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: ...Oh, just shut up, Red Fang! This is not a beast ship, I need some time to take care of things.
rows.speaker: Craftsman

rows.text: You willingly donned the skin of a lowly beast to join this mission, dedicating yourself to our glorious cause. And now you're telling me you can't handle it? Do you realize how many ships we need?
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Soldier

rows.text: I'm doing my best, alright? It takes time to figure all this out.
rows.speaker: Craftsman

rows.text: When the guns go off tomorrow, all eyes will be on it. That'll be our only chance...
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Commission Member

rows.text: Harr-zaa-xi? Wh—Who's there!?
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Soldier

rows.text: Who are you guys?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Taking advantage of the temporary absence of the group, you cautiously approach a crate and crawl inside.
An impromptu inspection. Why are there outsiders loitering in Stargazer Navalia? And a bunch of kids at that!
rows.speaker: Craftsman

rows.text: Hey, kids, didn't your parents ever tell you to stay away from the Stargazer Navalia? I know it's an automated facility, but it doesn't mean you can just break in and do what you want.
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Commission Member

rows.text: Ah, sorry, I'll take the little ones away right now.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You hear footsteps pacing back and forth beside the crate. If someone were to open the crate at that moment, they would certainly catch you in your ridiculous hiding position. Fortunately, that doesn't happen.
The floating mechanism at the bottom of the crate is activated. You feel it begins to drift slowly forward.
Seizing the moment when the suspicious "official personnel" temporarily step away, you tread on thin ice to reach a crate, attempting to slip inside.
Unfortunately, the crate is crammed with an assortment of petite, intricate mechanism devices.
First of all, I'm an adult. Second, I didn't just break in...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: After what feels like an entire Amber Era of holding breath in silence, you heard the sound of the crate touching down.
Yeah, we flew here on a starskiff! Like... woosh!
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Well, I'm not trying to tell you off, but this place is off-limits to the public, you know?
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Commission Member

rows.text: Big sis! Let's go! I want to play in Ever-Hunt Plains!
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Huh? Ever-Hunt Plains? Uh... yeah, sure! Big sis will take you there.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Xuu haa... You should have let me...
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Soldier

rows.text: The departing footsteps sound like a signal, prompting you to breathe a sigh of relief.
Shhh, the overhaul is done, and everything looks good. We should leave.
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Commission Member

rows.text: Could you repeat what you just said, Yanqing?
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: What did I say?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Don't be so paranoid! We're running out of time. Get over here!
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Soldier

rows.text: Big sis! Let's go! I want to play in Ever-Hunt Plains!
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Come on. Can't you read the room? Something is definitely off about the three people we just met.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Yeah, anyone could see that. I just wanted to hear you say it again.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: That pink-haired fox tried to say something. I'm pretty sure he sensed something fishy. Since he's not familiar with this place, he just dropped us a hint, but you didn't seem to be paying attention at all.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: I knew that from the beginning!
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: That Cloud Knight... didn't recognize Master Yanqing?
Looks like they were tampering with the starskiff production line, huh?
That Cloud Knight didn't recognize Master Yanqing at all... That's really weird.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What, is he famous on the Luofu or something? Not even the Cloud Knights on the Zhuming, who all know my glorious name, might recognize my face.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: You have a point.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Someone from the pack will be waiting for me once I leave the port...
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Soldier

rows.text: Lord Mok Tok has already prepared everything...
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Soldier

rows.text: Keep looking...
Pay attention to your surroundings.
There's quite a number of things to prepare...
The ship is paramount.
Mok Tok's request must be seen to.
Understood.
They said they were doing an overhaul, but it looked like they had no idea how to operate the starskiff production line, right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You lost track of the target... maybe give it another try.
And it's suspicious how they suddenly finished their "overhaul" and walked away as soon as they laid eyes on us.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: A Cloud Knight, a member from the Sky-Faring Commission, and a craftsman... They're from various departments, and the reason for the overhaul seems legit, but one of them blurted out some weird language just now. Did you hear that?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: I have a feeling that if we secretly tail them, we'll definitely catch these guys in the act.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Follow my lead, and be careful not to blow our cover.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Strange...?
What's this smell around here?
This mission is critical.
You were discovered by the target... maybe give it another try.
Never mind who they are, let's just film them.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Don't get too close, Miss March! They might spot you!
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: We should have just killed those lowly beasts.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Soldier

rows.text: Those little brats won't take up much space. There are boxes all over this place. Just dump them into one and no one will notice.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Soldier

rows.text: Cut the theatrics, Grulok. Even the slightest slip-up could interfere with Lord Mok Tok's plans.
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Commission Member

rows.text: So, where are we heading next?
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Soldier

rows.text: To check the freight skiffs. We've got a lot of preparations to do. Also, don't forget to take those crates with you.
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Commission Member

rows.text: Weapons, supplies... we've got to be well-prepared. Otherwise, we're screwed.
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Commission Member

rows.text: So, are they... smugglers? What exactly are they up to?
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: I have no clue, but they seem to be moving those crates. I've got an idea. We can hide inside the crates and follow them.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Nope, won't fit... Better try another.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ugh, it's so cramped in here...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I can hardly breathe.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Just hang in there...
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Let's just put the cargo here for now, alright? Then we'll move on to inspect the ships.
rows.speaker: Craftsman

rows.text: Lord Mok Tok said that as soon as we're done, we're to board the freight skiff and leave this place.
rows.speaker: Craftsman

rows.text: Don't worry. I've changed the shipping schedule. You two, come with me.
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Commission Member

rows.text: Is it just me? I keep smelling that stench of lowly beasts everywhere we go.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Soldier

rows.text: Don't be so paranoid.
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Commission Member

rows.text: Looks like they're planning to escape on the skiffs in Stargazer Navalia.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: They're keep talking about their "plans," but where did they come from? And what do they want to do on the Xianzhou?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: They're definitely up to something bad. Wait, they disappeared? Let's catch up to them!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Tread softly, breathe quietly...
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: And make sure to keep an eye on them. Hide out of sight as soon as there's any sign of activity.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Did he spot us? Quickly, hide!
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Watch out! They're on high alert!
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Something doesn't smell right. There's a weird scent...
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Commission Member

rows.text: Who's there? Show yourself!
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Commission Member

rows.text: I knew something was off. There's always this stench of lowly beasts in the air...
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Commission Member

rows.text: Looks like those brats were following us the whole time.
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Commission Member

rows.text: Why are they coming back? Quickly, retreat!
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Xuu harr, I'm coming!
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Commission Member

rows.text: They're leaving. We should catch up to them, quickly!
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: What are they up to? They're all wearing official uniforms, but I'm pretty sure they're not members of the Sky-Faring Commission, the Artisanship Commission, or the Cloud Knights... This is way too suspicious.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Never mind who they are, let's just film them. That way, if they do anything bad, we'll have solid evidence against them.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Look at this, a freight starskiff with enough room to fit at least twenty of my men. I'll let the others know and have them prepare more starskiffs.
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Commission Member

rows.text: Once we're past the checkpoint, there will be beast ships waiting for us.
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Commission Member

rows.text: Lord Mok Tok is ready. The revival of our ancient bloodline all hinges on this operation...
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Commission Member

rows.text: What did he just say?... Beast ships?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Who's there!?
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Commission Member

rows.text: It's those brats! I told you to get rid of them, but you didn't listen, you idiot!
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Soldier

rows.text: Wipe them all out!
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Soldier

rows.text: How is this possible? How did these foxians... change their appearances like that!?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: They're not foxians at all. They revealed their true form. They're borisin, just like the bandits I defeated on the IPC ship.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Wait, that means...
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: How did the borisin manage to infiltrate the Xianzhou?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What kind of trick did they use? When we were tracking them earlier, they looked just like normal Xianzhou foxians...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's not just a simple disguise of wearing our clothing and shaving their whiskers. They're somehow able to alter their appearance to be indistinguishable from foxians.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: They even have official IDs for the Sky-Faring Commission, the Artisanship Commission, and... even the Cloud Knights?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Let me check this fake Cloud Knight's tag. Maybe it'll give us some clues.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Lujun? An officer of the patrol defense squad... Wait!
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: What's the matter?
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: I encountered a patrol officer named Lujun before. It was a few weeks ago when we were transporting the borisin prisoners.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: If they can forge official identities and move around the Xianzhou without raising suspicion... Oh no, this is bad.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Even worse. If you find one cockroach on the Express, it usually means...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: There are more borisin hiding on the Xianzhou. I bet their plan is much bigger than just stealing information.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: We've got to report this to the Seat of Divine Foresight!
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Meanwhile, in the Seat of Divine Foresight...
I am glad to finally meet you in person, guests from the Astral Express. I'm Feixiao, the general of the Xianzhou Yaoqing.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Let me introduce our guests to you. The one dressed in green...
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: He's the reincarnation of Imbibitor Lunae, and the person behind him is the newest member of the Crew. I've heard a lot about you.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: It all comes down to the Stellaron.
We are the good guys.
Raise her suspicion about your relationship with Stellaron Hunters.
Talk about Elio's prophecy.
Apart from the Luofu, there are many other worlds suffering from Stellaron corrosion. For example, Jarilo-VI, the world that the Express stopped at before reaching the Luofu, was one of them.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: To the Express, Stellarons act as roadblocks on the silver rail and pose risks to the warping process. And that's why dealing with Stellaron issues is part of the duty of the Nameless.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Ah, I've heard about those problems caused by Stellarons. The Express connects various worlds, so it makes sense for you to take care of this. The Cosmos is a mess, and the Trailblazers are just doing their best to fix it. I understand.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: What's wrong with doing something good? Along the way, we've helped countless worlds... well, not literally countless, but you get the idea!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The Stellaron Hunters warned us that if we didn't hurry to the Xianzhou Luofu, half of its inhabitants would die.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Your good intentions are commendable, just like the Cloud Knights' determination to eliminate those abominations. Even though there are always people who remain skeptical, I won't question your motives.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: You know what? Maybe I do have a connection with Stellaron Hunters...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Oh...? Now that's interesting.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Looks like you're quite close to the Stellaron Hunters. However, I must warn you that they are wanted felons. While I appreciate your honesty, being honest about this topic might make you look suspicious to some, you know?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Rumor has it that Elio, the leader of the Stellaron Hunters, possesses the power to see into the future.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: He foresaw that the Xianzhou and the Express would have important roles to play in the war against Nanook. That's why we were lured here to the Luofu, to deal with the Stellaron crisis and fulfill the prophecy.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: General Jing Yuan believes in this prophecy too, as mentioned in the report. I'm curious why you didn't question it at all?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Could it be because one of the Stellaron Hunters is actually {RUBY_B#Blade}an old acquaintance{RUBY_E#} of General Jing Yuan?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Please be cautious with your words, Merlin's Claw. Let's avoid sowing doubt among our comrades. That Stellaron Hunter used to be my disciple, so are you putting my loyalty in question, too?
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: I'm simply bringing up the doubts about General Jing Yuan that exist within the Alliance. Since I'm representing them, perhaps you can just imagine me as one of those old geezers?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Outside the reports from the Luofu, the Sky-Faring Commission of the Yaoqing has also gathered plenty of information about both of you. I've been eager to meet you face to face, for reasons that... I'm sure General Jing Yuan has explained, right?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: According to General Jing Yuan's report, the {RUBY_B#Antimatter Legion}Ruin Legion{RUBY_E#} is to blame for the Ambrosial Arbor crisis, and all Arbiter-Generals should pay attention to the Ruin Author's movements.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: The Preceptors of the Luofu seem suspicious.
I've personally met Dan Shu.
The exile of Imbibitor Lunae is what led to this calamity.
Refuse to answer anything.
The answer seems rather simple, doesn't it? The Preceptors of the Luofu abandoned their duty to guard the Ambrosial Arbor and colluded with the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: That's a possibility, but there's another scenario to consider: General Jing Yuan brought back Mr. Dan Heng, who had been in exile for a long time. As a result, Dan Heng parted the Seas, eventually leading to the resurrection of the Ambrosial Arbor.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: I never intended to trespass on the Xianzhou ship, but...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: If you had no intention to trespass, then why did you return to the Xianzhou ship before your exile was lifted?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: I was concerned about the safety of my companions, so I had to act brazenly. I alone bear the blame.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Please don't worry, Mr. Dan Heng. If someone must be held accountable, it won't fall solely on your shoulders.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: I personally met Dan Shu once. Her closest friend was killed during the war on the Fanghu, and she harbored deep hatred towards The Hunt. So she spent years making preparations in the Alchemy Commission, in order to take revenge on the Xianzhou.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Revenge... is also a form of The Hunt. However, that doesn't explain how she managed to bring the Stellaron into the Scalegorge Waterscape, which was guarded by the Vidyadhara.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Well, you should ask Dan Shu herself for the answer.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Unfortunately, Dan Shu is dead, and even her corpse has crumbled into ash. That's one less clue we can pursue.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: If the Luofu hadn't exiled Dan Heng, leaving the Vidyadhara with no leader, they wouldn't have fallen into chaos, and there wouldn't have been the opportunity to bring the Stellaron to the Roots of the Arbor unnoticed.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Imbibitor Lunae was exiled due to his own crimes. Now, Dan Heng, as his reincarnation, is free from his sins. However, why did he risk trespassing on the Xianzhou Luofu before his exile was lifted?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: I was concerned about the safety of my companions, so I acted brazenly. I admit I was reckless at that time, but...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: But you returned despite everything. Now let's consider the outcome: The Arbor was resurrected, and the Luofu required a high elder to repair the seal and suppress the plaguemark. It's hard not to think about the stakes involved, right?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: I don't believe we are in a position to answer this question. We Nameless came here to resolve the Stellaron crisis, and we cannot be expected to know the details of Dan Shu's conspiracy.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: You make a valid point. That's how innocent people should react. Let's skip this question for now.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Over the years, the Destruction's minions have wreaked havoc on countless worlds, and the Alliance has been keeping an eye on them. But no one expected them to join hands with the remnants of the Abundance.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: The damage caused by the Ambrosial Arbor crisis was far less severe than expected, which is good news for us. However... it was quite different from the Ruin Legion's usual style of destroying life wherever they go.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Fu Xuan, the Master Diviner, witnessed everything firsthand.
Phantylia is a heliobus.
Phantylia was eager to obtain the power of Ambrosial Arbor.
Refuse to answer anything.
Back then, we were working with Diviner Fu, and she also witnessed Phantylia's true form. You're not going to doubt one of your own people, are you?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Of course not, we can trust the testimony of Master Diviner Fu Xuan. However... even if she saw it with her own eyes, we can't completely rule out the possibility that she might have been deceived. After all, it's suspicious how the culprit just bizarrely vanished.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Phantylia is one of the heliobi, the energy lifeforms that once fought against the Xianzhou. They're known for their unpredictable and elusive nature.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Just as [Trailblazer] said, when the Ambrosial Arbor resurrected, its roots broke through the Creation Furnace on the Luofu, accidentally releasing the heliobus fiendfire sealed inside. This can be used as circumstantial evidence.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: If Elder Huaiyan accepts the explanation, so do I.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: I was there, fighting Phantylia alongside General Jing Yuan, but she absorbed the power of the Ambrosial Arbor and gained an almost indestructible physical form. Perhaps that was her intention all along.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: So, a pawn of the Destruction wanted a flesh-and-blood body to live in? Hmm, interesting. That's quite a new perspective.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: I'm not sure how to answer that question.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The Lord Ravager is a master manipulator, adept at setting traps that lead her enemies to ruin. The current suspicions of General Feixiao towards the internal affairs on the Luofu are likely also...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: So, I'm not even allowed to ask questions? Asking questions is considered sowing discord now? Well, that's convenient for you, just like Phantylia vanishing without a trace.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Could you please give us another chance? I'd like to answer that question again.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: No problem, but remember that a debate is like a duel. The more you hesitate, the farther you are from victory.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: You've decided to withhold your opinion on this question.
Feixiao offers a slight smile, displaying no anger.
You silently fix your gaze on the Merlin's Claw, a trace of a provocative smile playing at the corners of your mouth.
Feixiao offers a slight smile, displaying no anger.
While I trust the bravery of the Divine Foresight and the Nameless, I'm curious about some details missing from the report. I'd like to take this chance to have an exchange with both of you.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Let me be clear, the questions I'll ask might not reflect my actual thoughts. So, please don't take offense if any of my questions seem a bit harsh.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Please go ahead, General. But keep in mind we can only answer based on what we know. And perhaps... you already have the answers to your questions in your heart.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You have a clever tongue. I like it.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: (The Merlin's Claw is quite articulate. Right now, her intentions are unknown, and Jing Yuan wants us to be honest... Maybe I'll just stick to the facts we know?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Let's cut to the chase. Before the crisis struck, the Astral Express was guided here by a Stellaron Hunter, a wanted felon, in an attempt to resolve the Stellaron Crisis.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: However, everyone in the Cosmos knows of the Stellaron Hunters' reputation. So, why did you place so much trust in them? Could it be that some of you have a connection with them?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Let's move on to the next question. The report suggests that Dan Shu, the Master of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus, colluded with the Lord Ravager and used the power of the Stellaron to resurrect the Ambrosial Arbor.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: But here's the thing: Dan Shu was just a chief alchemist. Even if she colluded with our enemies and summoned the Stellaron, how did she manage to bypass the Vidyadhara guards around the Ambrosial Arbor?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: According to the report, Lord Ravager Phantylia is the mastermind behind the entire conspiracy.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: She disguised herself as an amicassador of the Sky-Faring Commission and traveled with you, only to vanish without a trace later on. It seems too convenient to label her as a scapegoat.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Generals, I am finished with my questioning.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: So, what do you think, General Feixiao? Have the doubts in the report been cleared up?
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: The two Nameless have been honest in their answers. Even though there are some tricky details, my intuition tells me there is nothing wrong.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: However, the three questions I posed earlier were not just for the Nameless, but for you too, General Jing Yuan.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: First, the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus grew uninterrupted on the Luofu, yet the Six Charioteers were not aware of it. That was a dereliction of duty.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Second, you believed in the Stellaron Hunters' prophecy and entrusted outsiders to solve the crisis, even granting them access to the plaguemark. That was a dereliction of responsibility.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Third, you insist on holding the Wardance right after the Ambrosial Arbor Crisis, putting the Luofu back in the spotlight. That is a dereliction of wisdom.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Merlin's Claw, is this your line of thinking... or the Ten Lords'?
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: From the moment I walked in, I made it clear that the questions I'd ask might not reflect my actual thoughts.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: ...The Disciples of Sanctus Medicus were deeply rooted and had been plotting for a long time. I admit it was my negligence for not noticing it earlier.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: As for the Stellaron Hunters' prophecy, I didn't believe all of it, but in the end, the Luofu did survive the Ambrosial Arbor crisis. So, I think it's safe to say that Elio's prophecy about the future holds some merit.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: And as for the Wardance... Do you think I'm unaware of the risks? However, risks can also be opportunities. The Luofu has lain low for too long. I believe it's time to stir up the dregs hidden in the depths and wash them away once and for all.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Just as I expected from our sophisticated Divine Foresight. You have a way with words. I like it.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: But unfortunately, ever since the report was submitted, the Alliance has been filled with rumors and speculation. Even within the Luofu, there are people accusing you of neglecting your duties, resulting in the Ambrosial Arbor's resurrection.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: So, what are your thoughts on all of this, General Feixiao?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: As a fellow Arbiter-General, I fully understand the difficulties of this position.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Personally, I think all these rumors are meaningless drivel. Across the sea of stars, the Divine Foresight knows better than anyone else what happened on the Luofu and the meaning behind it...
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: ...Just as what happened on the Xianzhou Yaoqing recently.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: You mean, the Xianzhou Yaoqing is also...?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: The scouts of the Verdant Knights have sent back reports that borisin are making trouble again. The borisin packs that were once divided and scattered have started swallowing each other up, forming larger and larger packs. Moreover, there's an entity named "Mangas" behind it all.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: An "entity"?
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: Me too.
I object!
Will you let us come back...?
Your willingness to help is truly heartwarming, youngsters.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: Worried that I might go back on my word and keep you in The Shackling Prison? Relax, if I wanted to do that, you'd already be behind bars. Once you're done with your testimony, you're free to come and go as you please.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Worried that I might go back on my word and keep you in The Shackling Prison? Relax, if I wanted to do that, you'd already be behind bars. Once you're done with your testimony, you're free to come and go as you please.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: According to the report, this entity... isn't actually a borisin. It's a woman claiming to be the Messenger of the Master of Immortality. She's described as having "twelve faces and twelve pairs of fangs, as cruel as poison and as elusive as quicksand." The borisin believe she'll give them a chance to rise again.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: That's Phantylia.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: That's right.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: You're lucky that I'm the one who came this time. If it were {RUBY_B#Youwu}the Patina Justice{RUBY_E#} or {RUBY_B#Yao Guang}the Seer Strategist{RUBY_E#}, this conversation might not be so friendly.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: I've always had faith in my instincts, so I don't doubt your good intentions. But the Alliance has its fair share of questions and doubts about the Luofu. So, my plan is to come up with an acceptable answer to satisfy the Alliance.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: What's in this plan, General Feixiao?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: General Jing Yuan, you already know what has to be done, but since you don't want to be the bad guy, I'll take care of it for you. You need the final word from the Ten-Lords Commission to quell any doubts.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: And for that, I'll have to ask the two Nameless to visit the Shackling Prison.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Are you imprisoning us?

No, I'm not imprisoning you. While you're there, I'll ask a judge in the Ten-Lords Commission's Interrogation Division to record a detailed testimony with the Karmic Mirror from both of you. We'll fill in the gaps that weren't covered in the report and silence any protests within the Alliance.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: ...I'm okay with that.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Then, as the Merlin's Claw requests...
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Feixiao gives you a once-over, and despite lacking any apparent reason, you feel scrutinized, as if she were sizing up an opponent.

Oh, there's one more thing. This testimony is for silencing the voices of opposition within the Alliance, but I would like to urge General Jing Yuan to listen to the pleas of the foxians on the Xianzhou Yaoqing.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: So, you are here for Hoolay?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Exactly. Hoolay is locked up in the Luofu's Shackling Prison. Since he is the Brood Lord of the borisin, I want to transfer him onto the Xianzhou Yaoqing and imprison him there. The recent movements of the borisin suggest they're planning something big, so we must act preemptively.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: It makes sense to have the foxians keep an eye on their arch-nemesis. Since you trust my judgment, I'll repay that trust. What do you think about all this, General Huaiyan?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: I was worried this would turn into a heated argument, but it seems like both of you are on the same page, solving each other's problems! I couldn't have asked for a better outcome!
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: And as for Hoolay, I'll send my lieutenants Jiaoqiu and Moze to check on his condition in prison and ready him for transport. If there are no more questions, shall we get this started?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Do you actually believe in the Stellaron Hunters' prophecy?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: I do.
Do you really believe us?
What are you looking at?
Feixiao gives a nod.
While words can be deceiving, your gaze, your breathing, and your scent... they reveal more than your words do.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: I trust my intuition more than any words.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: No, I don't.
I don't know.
Yes, I do. That's why I'm here.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: No, I don't. That's why I'm here, to prove that the prophecy is not real.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The Xianzhou's Matrix of Prescience can also predict the future... Do you believe in its prophecies?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: We're ready to go in.
Just one moment, please.
...I understand.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: You're definitely a unique individual, just like Huaiyan said.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: I hope you'll walk alongside the Reignbow's path as a friend.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: I'm really sorry about all this, [Trailblazer], but the testimony in the Shackling Prison won't take up much of your time.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: I'll call for a messenger to take you to the Interrogation Division. You just need to give your testimony and then you can head back. So, no need to worry.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: As you wish, General.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Let's get going.
Maybe just one moment?
As General Jing Yuan requested, everything is prepared for your arrival, and I am here to receive you. The judges at the Interrogation Division also know your purpose in coming.
rows.speaker: Messenger

rows.text: Some time later, a starskiff carries you and Dan Heng to a place that looks strikingly familiar...
The Shackling Prison... I didn't expect to be back here after all these years.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Dan Heng...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Don't worry about me.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: This is the entrance to The Shackling Prison?
If you're ready, I'll open the gate for you.
rows.speaker: Messenger

rows.text: Wait, is The Shackling Prison inside the Scalegorge Waterscape, too?
Once I step through that door, I'll be inside the prison?
This is one of many entrances used for temporary access. Since you're not actual prisoners, it makes sense for you to use this entrance. Please come on in, dear guests.
rows.speaker: Messenger

rows.text: If you're ready, I'll open the gate for you.
rows.speaker: Messenger

rows.text: We're ready to go in.
Just one moment, please.
Well, technically, The Shackling Prison is spread out across multiple delves, and the ancient sea is just where they overlap. Please come on in, dear guests.
rows.speaker: Messenger

rows.text: Exactly. Please come on in, dear guests.
rows.speaker: Messenger

rows.text: What are you looking at?
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: The Shackling Prison on the Luofu... is completely different from the one on the Yaoqing. It's completely underwater.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Whether it's in the clouds or underwater, breaking free would still be a piece of cake for me.
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: You're still thinking about your old jailbreak tricks, huh? Forget it. You're free now. Just don't do anything stupid, or the judges will throw you back in there and lock you up for a few hundred years.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: You'll see me again in just a few days.
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: Taking Hoolay back to the Yaoqing means a lot to the foxians on the ship and to the General herself. So, stay alert.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Guests, my name is Xueyi, and I'm here on orders from the Incarceration Division of the Ten-Lords Commission.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: We're Jiaoqiu and Moze. General Feixiao sent us to extradite the borisin criminal Hoolay to the Yaoqing.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: We're here to inspect the conditions of his imprisonment and make preparations for the handover and transportation. I assume you've been briefed, your honor.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Your visit request has been approved. I'll be your guide for this trip.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Prisoner Hoolay, the Warhead and Brood Lord of the borisin Abominations of Abundance and the arch-nemesis of the foxians, is responsible for 2,123 wars of aggression and countless associated crimes.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Due to his heinous acts, he has been imprisoned in the depths of The Shackling Prison and subjected to the punishment of the Forest of Swords until the end of time. He shall never be pardoned...
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: No need to repeat his crimes and sentence, your honor. He is the greatest enemy of us foxians. The stories of his atrocities are used to terrify our children. I'm well aware of every crime he's committed. Let's move on to the next step.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: When it comes to visiting criminals, there are rules in place to ensure your safety.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: I know you've heard legends about Hoolay since you were children, but your knowledge about him is likely very limited. Only the judges of the Ten-Lords Commission truly know what kind of abomination is locked up at the bottom of The Shackling Prison.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: It has been centuries since Jingliu, the former Sword Champion of the Luofu, captured Hoolay. And during all those years, we never provided him with any food. Yet he's somehow managed to stay alive. It defies all the documented physical characteristics of the borisin.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: The Forest of Swords, forged by the Punishment Division, is a device of intense torment used to execute sinful abominations. Most borisin die within three days in the Forest, but Hoolay is different. Every time the blades pierce him, his body instantly heals. Despite the brutal punishment, he somehow manages to survive.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: The complex rules are there because of his abnormal characteristics. Do you understand now?
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Are you okay, Dan Heng?
Why can't they record our testimony outside The Shackling Prison?
Since the judge isn't here yet, I'll just wander around a bit.
Sorry, I was just reminiscing about some unpleasant memories.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Once we're done with the testimony, we'll leave immediately.
Even if you can't escape your past, we're always here for you.
Thank you, [Trailblazer]. It's all my fault that you were involved in the Xianzhou's problems. You shouldn't have to see the inside of The Shackling Prison... I'm so sorry.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I wish I could show you the real sights of the Luofu.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Dan Heng gently pats your hand.
The Six Charioteers might have more power over the rest of this Xianzhou ship, but here, in The Shackling Prison, it's the judges of the Ten-Lords Commission who call the shots.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The judges will use a complicated interrogation device called the Karmic Mirror. It accurately tracks every physiological change during questioning and records it.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Therefore, the judgment made here will be sufficient to convince the other administrators of the Xianzhou... At least they won't attempt to challenge the conclusions. Perhaps that's why Feixiao insisted that we come here.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Okay, but watch your step. This place is not like the others.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I apologize for any offense caused... Please continue, your honor.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: I've given you the instructions regarding Hoolay's visitation. Please make sure you read them carefully.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: And please take this pellet before proceeding.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: No, I'm not taking random medicine.
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: Then you won't be allowed to visit Hoolay.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Just swallow it already. Hoolay is like all borisin, he can release a pheromone called Lupitoxin that induces fear.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Thousands of years ago, we foxians were enslaved by the borisin, not because we were naturally weaker, but because of their Lupitoxin. This pill is for our own mental well-being.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: I understand.
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: I knew you were a reasonable person. Now that we've taken the medicine, let's proceed.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Your honor...
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: What is it?
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: No, never mind, maybe I'm just imagining things... Let's keep moving.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Here we are.
rows.speaker: Messenger

rows.text: Her Honor hasn't arrived yet. Please wait a moment.
rows.speaker: Messenger

rows.text: This place... it's still as cold as it used to be.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: So, are there really eighteen floors here?
Why keep the terrain so dangerous?

You're funny, [Trailblazer]. This prison does contain many layers. We even brought in Vidyadhara Ichor Line craftsmen to introduce the ingenuity of delve enchantment. What you're seeing now is just one part of The Shackling Prison.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Is that true, Dan Heng?
Perhaps. Judging from the appearance, much of the architecture in this prison has a Vidyadharan style... So perhaps they did have a hand in building this place back then.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: As for how many floors there are...? Well, not even us judges know for sure.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: But there's a legend among us judges that a short-life prisoner once tried to escape but ended up falling into the depths... and when we found him at the bottom, he was already an old man on the brink of death...
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Did he spend his whole life falling? Or did some long-life prisoner drain his life essence? We'll never know. Anyway, please don't try anything like that.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: You're funny, [Trailblazer]. This prison does contain many layers. We even brought in Vidyadhara Ichor Line craftsmen to introduce the ingenuity of delve enchantment. What you're seeing now is just one part of The Shackling Prison.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Is that true, Dan Heng?
Perhaps. Judging from the appearance, much of the architecture in this prison has a Vidyadharan style... So perhaps they did have a hand in building this place back then.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Well, the paths here serve as both passageways for the Ten-Lords Commission and barriers for the prisoners.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Most prisoners locked up here have committed serious crimes violating the Xianzhou Legal Code, and many of them are Denizens of Abundance like borisin, houyhnhnm, and {RUBY_B#featherines}wingweavers{RUBY_E#}. To be honest, these abominations... are pretty good at trying to break out.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: So, as long as the treacherous terrain here makes it harder for them to escape, the Ten-Lords Commission doesn't have any complaints.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Welcome, dear guests from the Express. Judge Hanya of the Interrogation Division, we've met before.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: To reach Scrivener Hall, we must take this elevator and go through the Frozen Prison.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Please brace yourself for the biting cold.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Miss Hanya?
It's you!?
Are you and your sister the only judges here?
Glad to meet you again, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: As one of the judges from the Interrogation Division, I'll be recording your testimony today.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Hmm? You don't want to see me, [Trailblazer]? Well, in that case, I can call in the judge who's an expert in acupuncture, or the one who's handy with axes and saws, or the one who knows all about whips and ropes... We've got plenty of options here, and we'll find one that suits your taste.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Just kidding. We judges work in shifts, and it just happens to be my shift, [Trailblazer]. Maybe we're destined to cross paths.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Please allow me to express my gratitude to you again for {RUBY_B#Subduing Heliobi}subduing the demons in the Fyxestroll Garden{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Looks like while March 7th and I were clueless, you already made many friends on the Xianzhou Luofu.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It was all a lucky coincidence.
Pom-Pom takes care of us at home, and friends take care of us on the road. That's just how it goes.

Even though [Trailblazer] and I have met before, we can't show any favoritism under the Ten Lords. So, please do as I command as we head to Scrivener Hall and beyond. Don't do anything without my permission.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: This is not a place for ordinary mortals. [Trailblazer] and Mr. Dan Heng, please come with me.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Please lead the way, your honor.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Please let me activate the mechanism before we all move forward, and please watch your steps.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Be very careful and watch your step as you make your way through.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: The terrain inside the Shackling Prison is treacherous. One wrong move, and you could end up plunging into the depths. And if you're really unlucky, you might be frozen solid or burned to a crisp before anyone can help you.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Gee...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: But with your skills, I don't think you need to worry about that.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Please come this way.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: I heard the Wardance is about to be held in the mortal world. I remember watching a sword duel at the Wardance with my sister when we were young.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: The Cloud Knight who was the Luofu's ringmaster was an amazing swordsman, and their sword flashed like lightning. The outworld challenger had fiery red hair and a hand made of steel which roared like thunder. They battled for a long time before a winner could be declared.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Time sure flies. Now, both my sister and I are residents of the netherworld, and we will never again feel the thrill of a competition.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Are there a lot of people in Starskiff Haven due to the Wardance, [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Yeah, it's bustling.
Aren't we going to take the elevator?
Sounds amazing. It's a shame I'm too busy to attend... but even if I could, I'd probably just scare people off with my current appearance.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Sorry, I got a bit distracted there.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Let's get going, then.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: A few moments prior, Xueyi leads the Yaoqing messengers to the bottom of the prison.
...It's freezing.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: This place is filled with the cold air from the Northern Peak of the Polar Delve.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Even the toughest long-life species would have a hard time enduring this.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Hmm? Did you hear something just now?
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Let me check it out.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Ugh, what an eyesore. This place is packed with boxes and crates.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: These crates... they look oddly familiar.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: A few days ago, the spiritfarers received reports about an IPC transport ship that was attacked by borisin. Then, a bunch of those abominations were dumped into this place.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: I had a feeling there would be trouble during the Wardance. But throwing both the pirates and the cargo in jail? That's a new one.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: The mechs in those crates are no joke.
Looks like the IPC has caught the attention of the borisin...

I heard the Intelligentsia Guild crafted something dangerous. We have many records in the Hall of Karma about these wise ones. They love to tinker with forbidden technologies, always trying to push the limits of ingenia.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: I caught a glimpse of the mechs in those crates, and they bear a striking resemblance to borisin. I wonder what they're planning this time?
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Well, business first. Let's keep moving.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: But how is this even possible? The spiritfarers followed the protocols, cutting off power to the mechs and sealing the crates. How could these mechs still start moving?
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: It's just like what happened in the Artisanship Commission before. These goods went haywire and attacked everyone in sight.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Lingsha mentioned there was some kind of biological tissue inside the mechs.
Where are the spiritfarers? Why hasn't anyone come to help us?
The Alchemy Commission members examined them and found some unusual structures within.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Something seems to be jamming communications within The Shackling Prison.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Looking down, you see a honeycomb of densely-packed prison cells extending deep into the darkness beyond your view.
You hazard a guess on the number of prisoners they are capable of holding here... Three thousand? Thirty thousand? Three hundred thousand? Wait, this may not even be the entire Shackling Prison!
Hanya blocks your way forward. She has been entrusted with the important task of ensuring that you only explore areas she deems safe.
Towering spirits with gruesome appearances glare menacingly at you, as if warning you to proceed with caution.
Their gazes converge at a pitch-black void, and you wonder what it's for.

When a "key" in the shape of a colossal sky-bearing column slots into the "keyhole," it unlocks the path to the Shackling Prison crypts, where criminals of high severity are held in subdued captivity.
That was the Nether Key — the key that keeps felons locked away behind the ultimate gate.
You see a cycrane twitching its head every so often, staring into space with a ghostly glint in its eyes.
Is there something that cannot be seen with the naked eye? You can't help but shudder at that thought.
You look at Moze, who shakes his head lightly at you. Guess this isn't really the time for jokes.
Perhaps the stifling and somber mood of the Shackling Prison has gotten to him, that's why he's neither up for chatting nor humoring you.
In the suffocating, empty darkness, an air of deathly stillness lingered about the gates of the cage that once confined Hoolay, chilling all who gaze upon it to the marrow.
The cage should have been virtually impossible to break out of, yet even it had failed to trap the savage beast for long.
It's probably these mechs causing the trouble.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: These things showing up in The Shackling Prison can only mean one thing...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: A prison break.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: And whoever delivered these "goods" clearly wanted them to go through the Xianzhou's strict inspection process, to show the Sky-Faring Commission and Cloud Knights how dangerous they were. They wanted these mechs to end up right here in The Shackling Prison.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: If these things already started taking action while nobody was paying attention, then the whole prison is in trouble, I'm afraid.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: And to make things worse, another group of visitors just entered the depths of The Shackling Prison, the messengers from the Xianzhou Yaoqing.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: And the prisoner they came to visit... might be the target whom these wolf-shaped mechs were delivered here for. If that vicious beast manages to break free... it will be a catastrophe for the Xianzhou Luofu!
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Here we are.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Have we arrived already, your honor?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Shouldn't there be a cage here?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: That's right, but don't worry, this isn't a trial. I just want to have a chat with you and get a better understanding of the facts.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: He didn't? That doesn't sound like the Divine Foresight I know.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Straight to the point. I like it.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: The most notorious felons are locked away in solitary delves deep down in the prison. Those delves can't be opened without proper authorization.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: "The blue bird paves the path, and the Stygian Lanterns illuminate it." Help me light up these lanterns, and the way to the bottom of the Shackling Prison will reveal itself.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: I've given you the diagrams for lighting the lanterns. Please take a look.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: The path is open. Once we descend to the bottom of the prison, please do not do anything reckless.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Inside the delve behind this door is the greatest enemy of the foxians, Hoolay.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Don't worry. Just tell her the truth.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Arrrrgh...
rows.speaker: Voice From Behind the Door

rows.text: According to custom, envoys from the Yaoqing visit the Xianzhou Luofu once every century to check on this abomination's imprisonment and condition.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Even though the Ten-Lords Commission sentenced Hoolay to the Forest of Swords, suffering every day for the rest of his life, I understand that the Yaoqing messengers want to see him dead...
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Unfortunately, for the past seven centuries, they've had to return disappointed, because this beast simply can't be killed.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: If we can use his toxin to create medicine and save an innocent life, it might help balance out some of the sins he has committed.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Could you be the key to a cure for the General, Hoolay?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: And once again, the envoys of the Yaoqing will leave disappointed. However, I won't say the same for me and my brothers...
Who's there!?
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: I'm just a humble counselor of the Rhinohound Pack. You can call me... Mok Tok.
Wardens! Intruders on the lowest level! Send reinforcements!
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Nobody will hear you here, at the bottom of the Shackling Prison.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: Thank you for opening up the prison for us, your honor. We'll take it from here.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: No wonder I kept smelling that familiar stench. So, it wasn't just my imagination. Do your thing, Moze!
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: We mustn't let these abominations get any closer!
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: {RUBY_B#how many years}How many times{RUBY_E#} has Verdantia spun around since our last hunt? Ah, {RUBY_B#scions of borisin}Duran's whelp{RUBY_E#}! Tell me your name!
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: O, Great Hoolay, nemesis of the foxians, and the hunter of all beings, I'm Mok Tok, a humble counselor of the Rhinohound Pack. I am only one insignificant heir spawned from your bloodline.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: It's been... at least seven centuries since you led our Pack through the hunting grounds of the stars. I'm thrilled to see that you are as cunning and skillful as ever.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: Seven centuries... Seven centuries have passed, but why have Duran's whelps grown to look like this? Tell me, Mok Tok, why have you grown to resemble our most despicable slaves and enemies, the foxians?
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: I've been commanded to release you from this cursed prison. It is {RUBY_B#fate}Sain Jiyaa{RUBY_E#}'s will. That's why I had to take a magic pill, don the skin of {RUBY_B#foxian}a lowly beast{RUBY_E#}, and play along with their hypocrisy.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: Since you have an escape plan, tell me, what's our next move to get off of this ridiculously large ship?
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: My brothers and I will lock down this prison, trapping the prison guards inside. This will buy us some time.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: The rest of my crew, who are undercover like me, will secure the vessels for our escape. According to the plan, we only have four hours to get out of here.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: Originally, I intended to carry out the plan tomorrow, but they're planning to transfer you to the Xianzhou Yaoqing now, so I seized this opportunity to set you free.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: What a reckless plan, you idiot! Even if we manage to get the ships, our chances of escaping are slimmer than a foxian slipping through my claws!
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: But we have no other choice! The angel serving under the Master of Immortality sent me with a message, "Only your return will end the prolonged divisions among the borisin."
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: Every one of my crew is ready to lay down their lives if it means setting you free.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: A sneaky weakling like you is actually showing some reckless bravery with this plan. Fine, you'll get what you want... and all of Duran's whelps will too.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Well then, my Lord, we should leave now.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: Before we go, give me one of those magic pills.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: My Lord... you seriously want to don the skin of a lowly beast? That would be a disgrace to your greatness, my Lord...
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: You idiot! Greatness means nothing without freedom! Once I get out, I'll need a disguise that won't raise any suspicion.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: As you wish, my Lord.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: Is that foxian slave my meal?
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: No, he's an envoy from the Xianzhou Yaoqing. I plead you to endure him a bit, my Lord, as he's more valuable as a hostage. Take him, guys! Time to move out!
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: After a brief but devastating loss of communications, the locked-down Shackling Prison is once more under control. The Express' Nameless may have emerged unharmed, but one of the Yaoqing envoys has been taken hostage.
Meanwhile, the borisin Warhead Hoolay, long confined to the depth of Shackling Prison, has vanished without a trace.
A pursuit between the hunter and the hunted will soon play out on the Xianzhou Luofu.
To Be Continued
Prison guards, stop them! For our great lord Hoolay!
rows.speaker: Borisin Wolftrooper

rows.text: (Howling noise)
rows.speaker: Borisin Wolftrooper

rows.text: Madam Hanya, the wardens in all areas are regrouping. Those ingenium enemies are wandering around and causing heavy casualties.
rows.speaker: Wraith Warden

rows.text: And to make things worse, those iron wolves broke open the cages and let the criminals out! We've called for backup, but it seems like all communication is jammed.
rows.speaker: Wraith Warden

rows.text: Let's preserve our strength and first take down the isolated prisoners. By decree of the Ten Lords, all prison breakers and intruders shall be apprehended, dead or alive.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: The man seems to materialize from the shadowy corners of the prison, as if he could vanish into thin air at any moment.

The "fugitive wearing a dark cloak," spoken of by Hanya, now stands before you. His face is devoid of any expression, cold and indifferent, yet... inexplicably, you could decipher this expressionless facade as if it whispered, "You're finally here."
The prison management on the Luofu is truly concerning...
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: You already said that a moment ago.
You look better when you're silent.
Hey, you're the Yaoqing messenger who fled!
So what if I repeat it? It's the truth after all. The prison management on the Luofu is truly concerning...
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: Is that so?
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: I prefer to be called "the Yaoqing messenger who strategically retreated."
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: At least two different groups of intruders infiltrated here — the {RUBY_B#borisin}wolf cubs{RUBY_E#} and these Mara-Struck Soldiers.
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: Good, it's still here.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: I wonder if it can still take us to the other side.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Just a short time ago, the Nether Key mechanism was activated. It was probably Madam Xueyi and the Yaoqing messengers, heading to the bottom of the prison. Given the situation, I'm afraid that area is exactly where our enemies are targeting.
rows.speaker: Aurumaton Spectral Envoy

rows.text: We mustn't let that vile beast escape from its cage!
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: We've gathered all the prison guards who can still fight, and we'll split up and secure each floor.
rows.speaker: Aurumaton Spectral Envoy

rows.text: Go!
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Those intruders are quite bold. They must have been planning this for quite a while.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Indeed, but borisin tend to favor direct and aggressive approaches. Crafting careful and precise plans like this... is simply not their style.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Let's focus on the current situation right now. Please help me!
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: What's the fastest way to the bottom of this prison, Miss Hanya? If we don't get there quickly, we'll soon be outnumbered by all the enemies inside.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: We'll have to bend the rules. Please follow me.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Though intermittent in its delivery, the cycrane provides you with succinct and essential intelligence.
By decree of the Ten Lords, all prison breakers and intruders shall be apprehended, dead or alive.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Yes, ma'am!
rows.speaker: Warden

rows.text: Hold your position here.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Yes, ma'am!
rows.speaker: Aurumaton Spectral Envoy

rows.text: We need a few tools if we want to reach the bottom quickly.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Follow me to the next floor.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: The path is cut off? Someone must have altered the mechanism.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: No matter, it'll just require a bit more work to get through.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Their hiding technique... it's pretty similar to the Wind Mantle technique used by the Vidyadhara serving Caelorum Venti on the Yaoqing. What do you think?
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: Some spiritfarers occasionally use ingenia from the Artisanship Commission to navigate the treacherous terrain here.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Normally, using devices like the shifting screen is strictly forbidden, as they could help prisoners escape.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: But given the urgency of the situation, let's just ignore the usual regulations.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: The Nether Key has been activated. I hope we're not too late...
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Hang in there, sister!
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Looks like there was a fierce battle here not long ago.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The gate to the prison delve is wide open. Hoolay has managed to break free.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Where are the Yaoqing messengers, and where's my sister? Are they still alive?
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Let's look around. Maybe we'll find some clues.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Xueyi... is here.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Miss Xueyi bravely sacrificed herself... My condolences, Miss Hanya.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Condolences? Well, that's unnecessary.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: We kick all those bad guys' butts!
We trap them inside this prison.
Both we and the intruders get trapped inside this prison.
With an indifferent gaze, he sized you up and down. Somehow, you deciphered his expressionless face as saying, "This person's lost their mind, how pitiful."

You misunderstand. Thanks to the Ten Lords' blessing, my sister turned into an ingenium centuries ago. Dying and returning as just a soul to the Hall of Karma's document office has become a routine for her.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: While I'm not keen on seeing her throw away her body like it's some replaceable part, but...
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: By the way, have you seen bodies that might be the Yaoqing messengers? One of them is a foxian wearing exquisite clothes, and the other wears a dark cloak, like a fugitive.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: ...No, I haven't found any foxian bodies, only borisin ones.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: So, the intruders and Hoolay are holding the Yaoqing messengers hostage.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: This is the worst situation. With hostages in their grasp, the prison guards can't do anything about the prisoners. If anything happens to the messengers, the relationship between the Yaoqing and the Luofu... could be irreversibly damaged.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: We must rescue the messengers, get out of here, and spread the news. We mustn't give up as long as there's a glimmer of hope!
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: What have you found, Miss Hanya?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Han... Han...
rows.speaker: Broken Cycrane

rows.text: Re... Reconstru...
rows.speaker: Broken Cycrane

rows.text: It's my sister. Looks like her soul hasn't returned to the Hall of Karma yet.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: At such a critical moment... her "death" can give us information that we can turn into an advantage.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Let me see. The damage isn't too bad.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: If I can fix it up, my sister will have a temporary body.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Hanya! I—I—I'm back!
rows.speaker: Repaired Cycrane

rows.text: Welcome back, sister. I don't know what kind of expression I should have at a time like this. Happy? Tears of joy? Ah, forget it. I'm used to you coming back in all sorts of forms.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: A cyber specter!
I will hold them back. Don't let Hoolay escape!
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Sharp fangs grew unchecked along the deceased's protruded lower jaw, bearing an uncanny resemblance to the other borisin corpses.
You begin to see why the borisin could easily infiltrate the lower levels of the Shackling Prison. They not only shapeshifted into the Cloud Knights, but into foxians too.
None of the assembly methods or formations work. The hanging ladder's mechanism must have been destroyed by those prison raiders that got here first.
You'll have to run on your own two feet to catch up to those prisoners now.
That's pretty convenient!
Your new form is kind of cute...
It's just a t-t-temporary solution.
rows.speaker: Xueyi (cycrane version)

rows.text: Just don't let me be d—d—damaged again... I'll lose my m—m—memories.
rows.speaker: Xueyi (cycrane version)

rows.text: Now is not the time for j—j—jokes!
rows.speaker: Xueyi (cycrane version)

rows.text: This cycrane can't... h—h—hold all of me...
rows.speaker: Xueyi (cycrane version)

rows.text: Sister, what did you see when you were "killed"?
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: One of the Yaoqing messengers escaped? And the other one was taken hostage and brought upwards?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The fugitives fled that way...
Let's maintain the order here...
We must fulfill our duty...
Mission accepted. Stop the fugitives...
Besides the borisin... there were... other... intruders... Invisible...
rows.speaker: Xueyi (cycrane version)

rows.text: Please stop those fugitives...
Invisible intruders? What does that even mean? How many conspiracies are tangled up in this mess?
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Do me a favor, sister. The intruders have cut off all communication between inside and outside the prison, and now you're the only person... the only bird... who can slip out undetected.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Make sure you deliver the news to the outside world.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: I... understand. Please be careful... sister. You... are different... from me...
rows.speaker: Xueyi (cycrane version)

rows.text: Time is running out, Miss Hanya. If we keep delaying, those borisin will escape from the prison.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Alright. If we happen to come across that Yaoqing messenger who got away...
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: No, stopping Hoolay should probably be our top priority.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Wait, something feels off. Something is approaching us.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The cycrane flaps its wings and unsteadily flies out of the lower levels of the Shackling Prison, charging straight into the depths of the shadowy passage.
Reset Successful
Hanya blocks your way forward. She has been entrusted with the important task of ensuring that you only explore areas she deems safe.
Her Honor hasn't arrived yet. Please wait a moment.
rows.speaker: Messenger

rows.text: In the suffocating, empty darkness, an air of deathly stillness lingered about the gates of the cage that once confined Hoolay, chilling all who gaze upon it to the marrow.
The cage should have been virtually impossible to break out of, yet even it had failed to trap the savage beast for long.
The invisible intruders?
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Well, never mind if you don't have any clues. Now is not the time to exchange assassination techniques.
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: I'm Moze. {RUBY_B#Jiaoqiu}My friend{RUBY_E#} fell into the clutches of {RUBY_B#Hoolay}that wolf{RUBY_E#}. I was planning to escape and report back as quickly as possible, but now it seems...
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: The prison on the Luofu is a real maze, I must admit.
rows.speaker: Moze
