rows.text: Thank you for your help, Mr. Moze. We'll do our best to ensure your friend's safety.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: At the same time, [Trailblazer], Dan Heng, and Hanya realize that the situation in the prison is out of control...
No, you can do nothing for him now, and you shouldn't be focusing on his safety at the moment.
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: You're so heartless!
But isn't he your friend?
Your friend is in Hoolay's clutches, and you're just going to leave him behind?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Look, I'm the Yaoqing General's guard, not his. I've seen how that giant wolf fights, and there is no way. Trying to save my friend will only get us killed.
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: I don't know how you think, but I won't throw my life away for a lost cause.
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: Listen up, I've been tracking these fugitives, and I know their next move. They're planning to seal off the entire prison to keep the outside world in the dark.
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: The worst-case scenario, we are all killed by that giant wolf, and the Shackling Prison is sealed off. No one will know about us or about their escape until it's too late.
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: And the best-case scenario...
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: No, we won't be able to. We're one step behind them.
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: Ah, looks like we've got some clever minds here after all.
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: The best-case scenario would be, we seal the gates and trap the enemy inside with us. We can't let that monstrous wolf escape.
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: Hopefully, someone will eventually notice that something is off and come to help. As for whether we'll still be alive by then, it's not something we should think about.
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: You sure have a way of comforting people, Mr. Moze.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: As a person of the Yaoqing, I've always searched for something meaningful to give my life to.
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: I have to make it out alive. My companions are waiting for me.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: As a netherworld dweller, I've already died once.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Well, then I'll give it my all.
I want to make it out alive, too.
Are we really out of options?
Yeah, we won't give up, not until the very last moment.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Don't worry. Even if we end up dying here, I won't let it happen to you first.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Well, you're just as good at comforting people as Mr. Moze.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: None of you are part of the Ten-Lords Commission, so sacrificing yourselves isn't the right move. As a judge, it's my responsibility to guard this prison, and if someone should step up to stop Hoolay from escaping, it should be me, not you.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Once we reach the gate, I hope you'll help me seal it. After that, I'll do everything I can to fight the borisin, and you find a safe place to hide and wait for reinforcements.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Now, let's proceed upward!
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: We must seal the entrance before the borisin fugitives get out.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: The Prison Wardens and mechanisms won't be able to hold them for long. Follow me!
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: We're almost there! The gate is just ahead!
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: The Shackling Prison has become a killing field. The prison guards try to resist, but Jiaoqiu can only watch them fall...
A-Rraaa...
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: This brings back such... familiar memories! Memories of chasing, gnawing, and tearing... They're back, they're back! They've all come back!
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: My Lord, we're just one step away from freedom. Once we pass through the gate, no one will be able to stop us.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: So, this hostage is useless now? Kill him, Mok Tok.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: (He's getting away... Do something, Jiaoqiu... It's just like the old days, you useless loser... Just do something...)
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Maybe this Yaoqing messenger can strike a deal in exchange for his life. He can use his status to help us escape from the Xianzhou. What do you think, Mr. Jiaoqiu?
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: Just look at you! Fallen so low during my absence! You're even negotiating with livestock? As far as I recall, no one from the Yaoqing would ever consider a deal with Duran's offspring.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: (I've got to... make this beast stay here... whether it's for the sake of Feixiao or the Yaoqing...)
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Deal. I certainly have more value alive...
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: My identity, my knowledge of the Xianzhou, and my understanding of many things that your minions have no knowledge of... They'll all be valuable.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Lowly beast, muster up that pitiful tongue of yours and plead for what remains of your life. Speak up.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: I'm afraid you're unaware, the woman who defeated you, Jingliu... She has recently returned to the Luofu.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Your opportunity for revenge is right in front of you.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: My Lord! This slave is talking nonsense. I've never heard anything about this! May I just kill him now?
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: Silence, Mok Tok! And you, slave... From now on, you'll stay by my side. You'll only speak and move when I allow you to. Otherwise, I'll dismember you, from head to tail, inch by inch. Got it?
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: But my Lord...
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: We must stay here for some time, Mok Tok. Fear not, because once I step out of the prison, it's the people of the Xianzhou who should tremble in fear. I'll show them what true calamity means.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Now, Duran's whelps! Follow me!
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Report! After we lost contact with The Shackling Prison, we received a message from a cycrane...
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Soldier

rows.text: The prisoners have revolted, and the criminal Hoolay... is nowhere to be found!
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Soldier

rows.text: What about the Yaoqing messengers and the Nameless?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: No news at the moment! We're trying to restore contact with The Shackling Prison as soon as possible!
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Soldier

rows.text: I see. You're dismissed.
rows.speaker: Feixiao
